topics.name: Install Sequence
topics.purpose: Define deterministic installation/reconciliation ordering from the `cs` root, including numeric/order metadata where declared, while keeping installation order separate from semantic ownership.

semantics.order_rule: Install sequence follows explicit numeric/order metadata where the installation profile defines it.
semantics.dependency_rule: Declared dependencies must be satisfied before dependent installation steps.
semantics.semantic_rule: Install order does not create ownership, authority or semantic parenthood.
semantics.atomic_rule: Each install unit has explicit success/failure state and rollback/recovery semantics where required.
semantics.runtime_rule: Installation does not automatically start/activate installed runtime components.
semantics.trace_rule: Install result records exact package/module/version/order/dependency evidence.

invariants.rule: Library discovery and installation are explicit source/package lifecycle semantics; filesystem presence, discovery order or installation never silently changes canonical identity, enables dependencies or activates runtime effects.

hard_gates.condition: filesystem order used as install sequence

references.purpose: Installed UserModules enter explicit lifecycle states.
